info.desc: Stillmatic is the fifth studio album by American rapper Nas, released on December 18, 2001 by Ill Will and Columbia Records. Nas' lyrics address topics such as ghetto life, American politics, and his feud with rapper Jay-Z. Stillmatic was a commercial and critical success and helped re-establish Nas' career, following a period of critical disappointment with his previous album Nastradamus (released in 1999). .......... .

podcast.body: Nas's 2001 album "Stillmatic" featured "Ether," a powerful rejoinder to Jay-Z's diss track "Takeover," solidifying its place in rap beef lore. The album was a critical response to the ongoing rivalry between the two New York rap kings. "Nas dropped Ether, a rejoinder from his 01 album Stillmatic."
